Ultimately building a self- sufficient culture where accountability, trust, and results thrive, leading to elevated readiness and more reliable performance. In support of this goal, the command has already established the baseline expectations over the last year by completing the “Outward Mindset” training modules through several on-site facilitated training and strategic planning sessions with the Arbinger Group. The proposed training program is intended to provide next level training, unify leadership, refresh strategic alignment, and create a more resilient and efficient leadership team. The expected outcomes from implementing the Outward Leadership and Outward Performance training are both cultural and operational. Our organization can anticipate stronger alignment, more consistent service delivery, increased team cohesion, and improved customer confidence. training program is intended to provide next level training, unify leadership, refresh strategic alignment, and create a more resilient and efficient leadership team. The expected outcomes from implementing the Outward Leadership and Outward Performance training are both cultural and operational. Our organization can anticipate stronger alignment, more consistent service delivery, increased team cohesion, and improved customer confidence. Specifically, the training aims to strengthen command climate and trust across all levels, increase accountability, and improve the speed and quality of decision-making. For the workforce, this translates to heightened situational awareness, increased productivity, and reduced burnout by providing clarity, purpose, and alignment. The ultimate expectation is to build a self-sufficient culture where accountability, trust, and results thrive, leading to elevated readiness and more reliable performance. 2. SCOPE Conduct leadership development training for 15 senior leaders and first-line supervisors that focus on Developing and Implementing Outward Leadership, an Outward Mindset Implementation series, and strategic working sessions. The training is the follow-on training to the Developing and Implementing and Outward Mindset co
